caption: The drawing features a single object centered on a plain, off-white or light beige background. The object depicted is a wooden item with a long, smooth, and slightly tapered blade or handle at the bottom; its color is a light brown with subtle wood grain texture visible. At the top, the handle transitions into an ornate, carved section, which is decorated with several overlapping, stylized leaves and a prominent, detailed flower-like blossom, all rendered in shades of brown and tan to resemble wood. The carved floral section includes fine lines that indicate the veins and details of the petals and leaves. There is a small inscription “MAX FERNEKES” in fine text at the lower right corner of the page. The composition is simple, with the object vertically aligned and taking up the central portion of the page, leaving wide margins of blank space around it.
title: Paper Knife
